I've seen data pipelines go from chaotic to streamlined with one powerful tool: AWS Step Functions. 
When I led the migration of a 10TB dataset to the cloud, Step Functions was instrumental in orchestrating our multi-step data pipeline.

Here are my top tips for getting the most out of Step Functions:
Use the AWS CLI command `aws stepfunctions create-state-machine` to quickly spin up a new state machine.
Leverage the `Task` state type to integrate with AWS services like Lambda, Glue, and Redshift.
Configure retry policies using the `Retry` section in your state machine definition to handle transient failures.
